# Espocrm

EspoCRM is an open-source web application that allows businesses to manage their customer relationships effectively.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/espocrm/.

## Actions

- **Get App User** (read-only): Retrieve current user data including token, acl, and preferences.
- **Get Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata information from espocrm.
